layout_description: Create a top left-to-right sequence of three white cards. Under the middle locating card, put a separate archive card feeding it upward. Current-applicability checking branches down-right to a verified-evidence card with the exact connector label "满足前提". Its second branch routes down-left to a larger requery card with the exact label "仍不确定". Requery has a dashed feedback arrow returning to applicability checking. A separate arrow from requery leads to the budget-exhaustion termination card. Keep the archive independent of environment requery; do not imply that rereading old bytes updates business state. Use color only for module borders, never red/green traffic signals or icons.

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 9-10pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
NO icons, NO pictograms, NO emojis, NO 3D rendering.
Feedback loop arrows are DASHED. Main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no decorative shadows.
source_excerpt: 此分路线输出经核对的证据、未满足前提与恢复成本。分别记录候选召回、读取完整、当前有效、正确使用四个环节；有效证据恢复率的分母是经独立标注确需回取且原文可用的事件，同时报告所有恢复请求中的失败比例。事件级指标只用于诊断，任务级终态承担主要结论。恢复风险和成本随后反馈给调度器，改变下一轮保留优先级。
